description: Na₄Mg(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.70 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-67°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (2.00 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-65°. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.95 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-71°. There are two shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.92 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Mo tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom.
